{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is sentinel (-999.0)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check the new shape and response rate
new_shape = df_clean.shape
new_response_rate = df_clean['responded'].mean()

# Check response rate by sex in clean data
response_by_sex_clean = df_clean.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Check if sex is balanced across arms in clean data
sex_arm_crosswalk_clean = pd.crosstab(df_clean['sex'], df_clean['arm'])

# Check if sex is balanced across severity in clean data
sex_severity_crosswalk_clean = pd.crosstab(df_clean['sex'], df_clean['severity'])

# Return results
print(f'Clean data shape: {new_shape}')
print(f'Clean response rate: {new_response_rate:.2f}')
print(f'Response rate by sex (clean):\n{response_by_sex_clean}')
print(f'Sex vs Arm cross-tab (clean):\n{sex_arm_crosswalk_clean}')
print(f'Sex vs Severity cross-tab (clean):\n{sex_severity_crosswalk_clean}')"}
